title: Materials Around Us
text:
Many things are made of different materials. A table is often made of wood. Wood is hard, and it is warm to touch. A glass is made of glass, and it is smooth and cold.

A sweater is made of wool. Wool is soft and warm. A rug can be rough, like a rope. Rough things are not smooth.

questions.text: What is a table often made of?
What is a sweater made of?
Why would a sweater be a good choice on a cold day?
options: It is rough like a rope

questions.text: What can you infer about the rug?
options: It may feel rough to the touch
It is very soft and warm

vocabulary.definition: flat, with no bumps or rough parts
not smooth; having bumps or an uneven surface
easy to press or touch, not hard

paragraph_translations: Muitas coisas são feitas de materiais diferentes. Uma mesa costuma ser feita de madeira. A madeira é dura e quente ao toque. Um copo é feito de vidro, e é liso e frio.
Um suéter é feito de lã. A lã é macia e quente. Um tapete pode ser áspero, como uma corda. Coisas ásperas não são lisas.
